name: Conventional Commit Lint
description: Validates that commit messages follow the Conventional Commits specification format (type(scope): description) before committing
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Validate conventional commit message format
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE 'git\s+commit'; then
  # Extract commit message from -m flag
  MSG=$(echo "$COMMAND" | grep -oP '(?<=-m\s["'\''"'\'']).*?(?=["'\''"'\''])' | head -1)
  if [[ -z "$MSG" ]]; then
    MSG=$(echo "$COMMAND" | grep -oP '(?<=-m\s)\S+' | head -1)
  fi
  if [[ -n "$MSG" ]]; then
    # Check conventional commit pattern: type(scope): description
    if ! echo "$MSG" | grep -qE '^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|perf|test|build|ci|chore|revert)(\([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\))?!?:\s.+'; then
      echo "WARNING: Commit message does not follow Conventional Commits format."
      echo "Expected: type(scope): description"
      echo "Types: feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|perf|test|build|ci|chore|revert"
      echo "Got: $MSG"
    fi
  fi
fi
exit 0
